correctness.rationale: Every five- and six-subset of the sixteen vertices is considered (4,368 and 8,008 cases). Exact forcing closure finds zero five-sets and 1,704 six-sets. Two implementations independently enumerate all legal one-for-one exchanges and all-pairs shortest paths, reproducing 16,560 edges, 1,704 eccentricities equal to six, all degree and distance histograms, and the 24 Johnson-excess-two exceptional pairs. No inference from incomplete finite sampling or infinite extrapolation.
